name: QuizFiesta
description: Quiz Fiesta is an interactive quiz app built using React. It allows users to select topics, answer multiple-choice questions, and track scores in real-time. The app is responsive, providing a seamless experience across devices.

paragraphs: Welcome to Quiz Fiesta! This is an interactive quiz application where you can test your knowledge across various topics. The app presents multiple-choice questions and tracks your score in real-time.
features: Multiple Topics: Choose from various categories and topics to challenge yourself with different quizzes.
Real-time Scoring: Your score is updated immediately after you answer each question, allowing you to track your performance.
Responsive Design: The app is fully responsive, so you can enjoy playing on any device, whether it's your phone, tablet, or computer.
Dynamic Feedback: Receive instant feedback on whether your answer is correct or incorrect after each question.
